name: Marker-driven iteration dispatch (Pattern A — propose while iter<=cap, synthesize at cap-exhaust)
description:
ADR-042 §Phase 2 redesign autoresearch pack — single iteration-loop driver. Replaces the previous rule 02 (baseline→propose) + rule 05 (length_lt cap continue) + rule 06 (length_eq cap stop) split. The split design ran into the monotonic-condition trap (count<cap stays true across iterations 1..N, so wasMatching stays true, TransitionNone+WhileTrue=empty → action_count=0 → chain stalls). Per upstream semstreams#204 guidance (2026-06-03), the canonical fix is the R4 presence-marker pattern (see configs/rules/research-graph/04-assess-dispatch.json in beta.95).

ADR-053 Phase 3a (2026-06-08): this rule now fires on the RUN entity (agent.chain.execution.<runID>), NOT the coordinator loop. The accumulator state (run.status, cap, iteration.pending, best.value, command, surface, …) lives on the run entity, so the `agent.loop.role==coordinator` condition was dropped — the remaining autoresearch.* conditions scope the rule to the run entity (the only entity carrying them). $entity.id / $entity.instance / $entity.triple.autoresearch.* now resolve against the run entity. The firing-entity-local read model is unchanged; only WHICH entity the driver fires on moved (see [[phase3-rule-firing-entity-blocks-rehome]]).

Mechanic:

1. emit_autoresearch_baseline stamps autoresearch.iteration.pending="initial" + run.status=active on the RUN entity (ADR-053 Phase 3a — was rule 01's add_triple on the coordinator loop), together with cap, baseline.value, best.value, command, surface, metric_parser, in one batch.
2. When that batch lands, ALL of this rule's conditions become true together on the run entity → TransitionEntered → iteration=1 → on_enter fires.
3. on_enter first action: remove_triple iteration.pending. Conditions flip false (pending=ne "" no longer holds) → TransitionExited → wasMatching back to false. This is what makes the next iteration produce a fresh TransitionEntered.
4. on_enter continues: publish_agent autoresearch-propose, gated by `$state.iteration <= cap`. The propose spawn proceeds for iterations 1..cap.
5. Propose runs, terminal=decide(measure). Rule 03 spawns execute.
6. Execute runs, calls emit_autoresearch_measurement (empirical compare), terminal=decide(measured). Rule 04a stamps experiment.completed AND iteration.pending=<entity.id> on the run entity. The new pending stamp restarts this rule's Entered cycle (iteration=2, 3, ...).
7. At iteration > cap, the propose-spawn action's when clause fails (false). The synthesize-spawn action's when fires (true). Synthesize spawns AND run.status flips via replace_owned to "stopped" (so this rule's run.status condition fails on any belated marker stamps — defense in depth against stale executes finishing after synthesize).

Why replace_owned for run.status flip (not add_triple): triples are append-only at the predicate-set level; GetFieldValue returns first matching triple. If we add_triple-d run.status="stopped" alongside the original run.status="active" stamp from emit_autoresearch_baseline, scalar eq reads would still find "active" first. replace_owned (ADR-056 Decision 3, semstreams#283 / beta.110) does an ATOMIC owned replace-by-(subject, predicate) via update_with_triples — one KV revision, no read-between-revisions gap (superseding the non-atomic update_triple remove-then-add this used 2026-06-03..2026-06-14). run.status is single-valued current-state owned by the rule-pack.semteams projection contract (replace-owned group on *.*.agent.chain.execution.*). NOTE the writer split: emit_autoresearch_baseline SEEDS run.status=active via add_triple (the executor's TriplePublisher has no owned lane); this rule's first replace_owned reconciles that seed away. On the observe-only tag this mixed-writer seed is benign; an executor-side owned lane is the separate follow-up (governed-skg-readiness.md feedback item B).

Why presence-marker (iteration.pending) instead of in-flight toggle: see semstreams#204 thread. Toggle patterns hit (a) add_triple append-only stacking and (b) GetFieldValue first-write-wins, so a later in_flight=true is invisible to eq "false" reads. Markers + remove_triple sidestep both — the marker either exists or doesn't, and the rule engine reads its presence (`ne ""`) rather than its value.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.autoresearch-propose
on_enter.prompt:
AUTORESEARCH PROPOSE — iteration $state.iteration of $entity.triple.autoresearch.cap.

The run entity at $entity.instance carries the full state: command, surface, cap, metric_parser, baseline.value, best.value, best.experiment_id, and one autoresearch.experiment.completed triple per iteration completed so far. Your prior-iteration context arrives inlined via the .triples substitution:

```
$entity.triple.autoresearch.experiment.completed.triples
```

That token resolves to a JSON-encoded array of execute loop IDs for every iteration completed so far. Parse the array; for each ID, call read_loop_result to read that iteration's reason field (hypothesis, value, pass, outcome). Use that journal to:

1. Avoid re-proposing changes that already reverted in a prior iteration.
2. Build on changes that were kept (which became the new running-best — best.value is $entity.triple.autoresearch.best.value).
3. Identify directions the journal suggests have headroom.

Iteration 1 — read the journal as described above. Also read the run entity's current state via the substitutions in your prompt: command is $entity.triple.autoresearch.command; surface is $entity.triple.autoresearch.surface; best.value is $entity.triple.autoresearch.best.value.

Iteration 2 — write your hypothesis to scratchpad. Concrete (file + change pattern + prediction). Within surface. Single-axis. Will not break the pass gate.

Iteration 3 — bash: apply the diff. Verify with `git diff --stat` that changes are scoped within surface.

Iteration 4 — decide(action="measure", reason="<hypothesis + diff summary>"). Rule 03 spawns execute next.

If the journal shows the metric has plateaued (last 3+ iterations all reverted with no kept) AND you have no novel hypothesis to try, decide(action="needs_clarification", reason="plateau observed after $entity.triple.autoresearch.experiment.completed.length iterations; running best=$entity.triple.autoresearch.best.value vs baseline=$entity.triple.autoresearch.baseline.value; no new hypothesis viable"). The recovery rule routes to coordinator, which can call respond_direct with the run's current state — soft stop because v1 substrate does not implement plateau-N as a hard stop condition.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.autoresearch-synthesize
on_enter.prompt:
AUTORESEARCH SYNTHESIZE — final rollup.

The iteration loop has terminated: $entity.triple.autoresearch.experiment.completed.length iterations completed against cap $entity.triple.autoresearch.cap. Stop reason: cap reached.

Your job is to produce ONE artifact summarising the run: the baseline, the running-best, the kept improvements (with their diffs), the journey, and any open opportunities the journal suggests.

Iteration 1 — read the run entity context via prompt substitutions:

- command: $entity.triple.autoresearch.command
- surface: $entity.triple.autoresearch.surface
- baseline.value: $entity.triple.autoresearch.baseline.value
- best.value: $entity.triple.autoresearch.best.value
- best.experiment_id: $entity.triple.autoresearch.best.experiment_id

Iteration 2 — read the per-iteration journal. The JSON array of completed execute loop IDs is inlined as $entity.triple.autoresearch.experiment.completed.triples. Parse the array; for each ID, call read_loop_result to read that iteration's terminal reason (hypothesis, value, pass, outcome). Build a chronological narrative: which hypotheses were kept, which reverted, which crashed.

Iteration 3 — read the best experiment's diff if best.experiment_id is not 'baseline'. bash: `git diff` against the workspace to see the cumulative kept diff.

Iteration 4 — call emit_autoresearch_artifact with the structured rollup (title, command, baseline_value, best_value, improvement_pct, cap, iterations_completed, iterations_kept, iterations_reverted, iterations_crashed, best_diff_summary, journey[], open_opportunities). Then decide(action="emit", reason="<one-line summary referencing the artifact slug + the improvement percentage>"). Rule 07 fires on this and spawns reviewer-autoresearch.

If the run produced no kept iterations (best.value == baseline.value), still emit the artifact — the negative-result rollup is the deliverable, with open_opportunities carrying the substance of why the surface was not productive. Reviewer-autoresearch grades structural completeness, not improvement magnitude.

metadata.replaces: rules 02 (baseline→propose) + 05 (length_lt cap) + 06 (length_eq cap) — single rule now handles iter 1, iters 2..cap, and cap-exhaust synthesize
metadata.upstream_thread: semstreams#204 — root-cause analysis of the prior in_flight toggle attempts. Diagnosed the monotonic-condition trap and prescribed the marker pattern as the canonical fix.
metadata.remove_triple_first_rationale: remove_triple iteration.pending fires before the publish_agent actions because action order matters for transition detection: clearing the marker flips the rule's conditions false, which is what produces TransitionExited and resets wasMatching for the next iteration's Entered transition. If we put publish_agent first, the propose loop might race against the marker still being present and trigger a stale evaluation.
metadata.when_clause_substitution_requires: semstreams beta.86+ (SubstituteConditionValues from #149) — value: "$entity.triple.autoresearch.cap" is substituted at evaluation time.
